### **Phase 1.1: Data Verification Logic**

The script operates on a simple but critical distinction in ALOS-1 PALSAR data architecture. Since FBS data has double the sampling rate of FBD, keeping FBD in a high-res FBS stack without specific upsampling would lead to complete decorrelation in those pairs.

| Data Type | Bandwidth | Polarization Files | Action in Script |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **FBS** | 28 MHz | IMG-HH only | **Keep** in ./SLC |
| **FBD** | 14 MHz | IMG-HH and IMG-HV | **Move** to ./removed\_FBD\_data |
